_doc: Tells (Dungeon Alive slice 5; known and unknown 2026-11-12; src/tells.py). Brandon: players must pay attention to lore, weaknesses and abilities (stay away from things that confuse; use ranged), and the notes must not give away what a creature is or how to beat it before the hero knows it. Each tell has three parts: 'sign' (what the eye sees), 'does' (what the creature can do to him), 'counter' (what to do about it); and a 'cue', the log's one line (2026-11-22, Brandon: 'you need a cue, not a soliloquy, especially for console messages'): the creature named and what it can do in a few words, never how to beat it. How much is said follows family_lore.knowledge: UNKNOWN hears the sign; KIN (its family at Recognise or Forewarned, the kind itself never studied) the sign, 'kin_lead' and what it does; KNOWN (studied, its page opened, or its family at Lore) all three, then what it is made of (tells.lore_lines, winning-build plan 2026-11-13 section 3.1; the sizes and the materials since the 3.5.1 audit, from affinity.damage_profile, the one reading the blow follows): 'weak_one'/'weak_many' with its weaknesses and {size} ('double'), 'bane_tail' (or 'bane_only' when it has no other weakness) with the materials it cannot bear, then one line of what it resists ('resist_one'/'resist_many') and shrugs off ('shrugs_one'/'shrugs_many'), then one of what its nature refuses ('immune', with 'status_words') and falls to easily ('easily', and 'fire_flight' for a beast that fire puts to flight). These are said at KNOWN even of a creature with no tell; then 'known_lead' goes first, so the creature is named before the lines that call it 'it' (bug bash WB-E02). A sign never names the mechanic or the counter. The counter is honest about reach: when the creature can put the effect on the hero from across a room (tells.reach), 'counter_far' is used, or 'far_counter' when the tell has none. 'splits' fills {split_by} from the creature's own splits.by; 'does_weak'/'counter_weak' are for a creature split by a weak blow. The first time in a run the hero sees a kind, the log says one line of its worst tell (tells.log_line): its sign to a hero who does not know it, its cue once he knows its family or the kind; said again when he comes to know the kind better, never the same line twice. Observe (O) says up to 'max_lines' of them in full (sign, does and counter, at what he knows). The 'pack_<trick>' tells are a pack's trick, not an attack's rider (src/packs.py, data/packs.json): a creature has one when its kind's pack has that trick. 'order' ranks the effects, worst first; 'min_chance' ignores an attack effect rarer than this.
far_counter: {He} can reach you from across a room, but only where {he} can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in.

rush.sign: {The} stands hunched forward, weight on {his} toes, ready to run at you.
rush.does: Shoot at {him} from afar and {he} rushes you, two strides a turn for a few turns; then {he} must catch {his} breath before {he} can rush again.
rush.counter: Let {him} come to you round a corner or through a doorway, or slow {him} before you start shooting.

regroups.cue: {The} runs for friends when beaten, and brings them back.
regroups.does: Beaten, {he} runs for the nearest of {his} own side and comes back with more of {his} kind; caught as {he} runs, {he} turns at bay.
regroups.counter: Finish {him} before {he} reaches them, or be ready for more when {he} comes back.

petrify_lethal.sign: Around {the} the stone has shapes in it: a hand, a shoulder, an open mouth.
petrify_lethal.cue: {The} can turn you to stone, and the stone kills.
petrify_lethal.does: {He} can start you turning to stone: in ten turns you would be dead.
petrify_lethal.counter: Carry Oil of Rue, the grey-green oily flask at every stall from floor 19. Cleanse, a cure-all or a prayer for mercy (a chain of four) stops the count too, and a mirror shield turns a gaze.
petrify_lethal.counter_far: Carry Oil of Rue, the grey-green oily flask at every stall from floor 19. Cleanse, a cure-all or a prayer for mercy (a chain of four) stops the count too. {He} can reach you from across a room: keep stone between you, or watch a gaze in a mirror shield.

petrifying.sign: Small things lie stiff where {the} has been.
petrifying.does: {He} can stiffen you toward stone, slow and then still for a moment.
petrifying.counter: It will not kill you. Gloves guard against a touch, a mirror shield turns a gaze, and Oil of Rue ends it.
petrifying.counter_far: It will not kill you, and Oil of Rue ends it. {He} can reach you from across a room: a mirror shield turns a gaze, and a wall turns anything.

forgetting.sign: {The} watches your head, as if it were the part of you good to eat.
forgetting.does: {He} can eat what you know: an identified thing, or a page of your Bestiary.
forgetting.counter: Kill {him} before you leave the floor and it all comes back. A Mind Ward, a helm or magic resistance keeps {him} out.
forgetting.counter_far: Kill {him} before you leave the floor and it all comes back. A Mind Ward, a helm or magic resistance keeps {him} out.

charmed.sign: You find that you would like to stand nearer {the}.
charmed.does: {He} can charm you: you cannot strike {him}, and your feet take you to {him}.
charmed.counter: Moly, magic resistance and a helm help against any charm, wax against a song, a mirror against a gaze. The first wound {he} gives you breaks it.
charmed.counter_far: {He} can do it from across a room. Moly, magic resistance and a helm help against any charm, wax against a song, a mirror against a gaze. The first wound {he} gives you breaks it.

knocked_down.sign: {The} means to go through you, not round you.
knocked_down.cue: {The} can knock you off your feet.
knocked_down.does: {He} can knock you off your feet, and getting up takes a turn.
knocked_down.counter: Meet {him} in Guard (Shift+S): in Guard you keep your feet. Good boots help.

gaze_paralyze.sign: Something about the eyes of {the} makes you want to look away.
gaze_paralyze.cue: {The}'s gaze can hold you where you stand.
gaze_paralyze.does: {His} gaze can hold you where you stand, from across a room.
gaze_paralyze.counter: Keep a wall or a pillar between you. Eyes that cannot see are safe from it, and so is a hero who watches {him} in a mirror shield, as Perseus did.

paralyzed.sign: {The} moves slow and sure, like a thing that never has to chase.
paralyzed.cue: {The} can hold you still where you stand.
paralyzed.does: {He} can hold you still where you stand.
paralyzed.counter: Do not let {him} reach you: fight {him} from a distance. If it is a gaze that holds you, a mirror shield turns it.
paralyzed.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room, but only where {he} can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in. If it is a gaze that holds you, a mirror shield turns it.

confused.sign: Looking at {the} too long makes the room tilt.
confused.does: {He} can scramble your thoughts until you cannot think straight.
confused.counter: Keep your distance, or end {him} fast. Wax in your ears stops a scream that does it; cold iron stops a fairy's glamour.
confused.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room, but only where {he} can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in. Wax in your ears stops a scream that does it; cold iron stops a fairy's glamour.

sleeping.sign: Just watching {the} makes your eyelids heavy.
sleeping.cue: {The} can put you to sleep where you stand.
sleeping.does: {He} can put you to sleep where you stand.
sleeping.counter: Never fight {him} with others close by. Wax in your ears stops a song that does it, and cold iron a fairy's.

frozen.cue: {The} can freeze you where you stand.
frozen.does: {He} can freeze you: feet stuck, hands numb, and your blows at half.
frozen.counter: Keep a lit torch in hand: it thaws you in a turn. Cold resistance keeps the ice off.
frozen.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room. Keep a lit torch in hand: it thaws you in a turn. Cold resistance keeps the ice off.

teleportitis.cue: {The} can fling you elsewhere on the floor.
teleportitis.does: {He} can fling you somewhere else on the floor, far from your way out.

feared.sign: Looking at {the} makes your stomach drop.
feared.does: {He} can break your nerve: you cannot go nearer {him} or strike {him}.
feared.counter: Have a bow or a spell ready, or your back to a wall: cornered, you can fight. Nepenthe ends fear, and wax stops a voice.
feared.counter_far: {He} can do it from across a room. Have a bow or a spell ready, or your back to a wall: cornered, you can fight. Wax stops a voice.

blinded.sign: Everything about {the} seems aimed at your eyes.
blinded.does: {He} can blind you: you see one tile, and quiz answers are dark but for a light you move.
blinded.counter: A helm guards your eyes, and a mirror shield turns a gaze. Blinded, move the light with the arrows.
blinded.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room. A helm guards your eyes, a mirror shield turns a gaze, and a wall turns both.

silenced.sign: {The} moves in a pocket of dead quiet.
silenced.cue: {The} can take your voice, and your spells with it.
silenced.does: {He} can take your voice, and your spells with it.
silenced.counter: Cast before {he} reaches you, or fight {him} with steel.

stunned.sign: {The} is built like a falling wall.
stunned.does: {His} blows can stun you: you see double, your first step falls and your first fumble drops.
stunned.counter: Fight in Guard (Shift+S) and you neither fall nor drop. Stunned, stand and fight rather than step or fiddle.
stunned.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room. Fight in Guard (Shift+S) and you neither fall nor drop.

immobilized.cue: {The} can pin your feet where you stand.
immobilized.does: {He} can pin your feet where you stand.
immobilized.counter: Pinned, you cannot run, but you can still fight and drink: fight {him} where you would not need to run.
immobilized.counter_far: Pinned, you cannot run, but you can still fight and drink: fight {him} where you would not need to run.

splits.sign: {The} looks as if {he} would come apart and keep coming.
splits.does: Strike {him} with {split_by} and there will be two.
splits.does_weak: Strike {him} with a weak blow and there will be two.
splits.cue_weak: {The} splits in two under a weak blow.
splits.counter_weak: Hit {him} hard, or not at all.

revive_once_on_death.sign: The wounds on {the} should have killed {him}, and did not.
revive_once_on_death.cue: {The} does not stay dead the first time.
revive_once_on_death.does: {He} will not stay dead the first time.
revive_once_on_death.counter: When {he} falls, keep your guard up.

drain_heals_self.sign: {The} watches your throat, not your blade.
drain_heals_self.does: {He} heals {himself} on your blood: every blow {he} lands mends {him}.

weakened.cue: {The} can drain the strength out of you.
weakened.does: {He} can drain the strength out of you.

diseased.does: The wounds {he} gives fester long after the fight.

corroding.sign: Where {the} has passed, the stone is pitted and crumbling.
corroding.does: What {he} touches rots and crumbles: your armour gives way while it lasts.

poisoned.does: {He} is poisonous, and every wound {he} gives keeps hurting after: the striped end of your health bar is what the venom will still take.
poisoned.counter: Carry a cure: a potion of cure poison, Cleanse, a meal against venom, or a prayer for mercy at a chain of four. A second bite adds half again; a hardy body throws off half.

regeneration.sign: The old scars of {the} have closed without a mark.

summon_kind.sign: {The} keeps glancing behind {him}, as if {he} expects company.
summon_kind.does: {He} can call others to {him}, a few at a time.
summon_kind.counter: Strike {him} while {he} chants: a blow breaks the call. Kill what {he} calls, and {he} must call again.

pull_chance.sign: {The} has a long reach with a hook to it.
pull_chance.cue: {The} can drag you to {him} from afar.
pull_chance.does: {He} will drag you to {him} from further off than you think.
pull_chance.counter: Stay well out of {his} reach, or close in on your own terms.

sp_drain.does: {He} is after your food: every blow {he} lands leaves you hungrier.

can_charge.counter: Make {him} come to you round a corner.

can_phase_blink.sign: {The} is never quite where you last looked.
can_phase_blink.does: {He} steps from place to place without crossing between.
can_phase_blink.counter: Distance will not save you: stand and fight.

stalker.sign: {The} keeps just out of reach and never takes {his} eyes off you.
stalker.cue: {The} stalks you, waiting for you to rest.
stalker.does: {He} waits for you to rest. Rest, sleep or lose your wits near {him}, and {he} is on you in a moment.
stalker.counter: Never rest where {he} can find you. Back {him} into a corner, or rest on another floor.
stalker.sign_friend: {The} follows you, smiling, offering to keep watch.
stalker.cue_friend: {The} is no friend: {he} waits for you to rest.
stalker.does_friend: {He} is no friend. {He} waits for you to rest, and then {he} strikes hard.
stalker.counter_friend: Never rest where {he} can find you. Strike first, or rest on another floor.

bleeding.does: The wounds {he} gives go on bleeding after the blow.

burning.does: {He} sets what {he} hits alight, and the fire keeps burning after.

slowed.sign: The air round {the} feels thick, like wading.
slowed.does: {He} can slow you: every action takes two turns, whatever you do.
slowed.counter: Good boots and quick feet throw it off. Slowed, spend no action you do not need.
slowed.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room. Good boots and quick feet throw a slowing off; close in or get out of sight.

hallucinating.cue: {The} can fill your head with visions.
hallucinating.does: {He} fills your head: creatures wear wrong faces, and quizzes grow a false answer that fades.
hallucinating.counter: Wait for the false answer to fade. Moly, magic resistance and Clear Sight keep the visions out, and cold iron a fairy's.

rust.sign: Every nail and hinge near {the} has gone to red dust.
rust.does: {His} feelers rust iron and steel: a brush takes a point off your weapon or armour.
rust.counter: Keep good steel out of {his} reach: fight {him} with wood or bronze.

pack_swarm.sign: You hear claws scrabbling in the dark all round {the}: {he} is never alone.
pack_swarm.cue: {The} and {his} kin swarm you, biting deeper together.
pack_swarm.does: Rats swarm: each one bites harder for every other rat beside you, so four at once are deadly and one is not.
pack_swarm.counter: Never let the pack surround you. Back into a corridor or a doorway, where only one rat can reach you, and kill the first one fast.

pack_feast.sign: The reek of an opened grave hangs round {the}.
pack_feast.cue: {The} and {his} pack feed on prey that cannot move.
pack_feast.does: When you cannot move, every ghoul near by falls on you to feed, and each bites harder at prey that cannot fight back.
pack_feast.counter: Thin the pack out before it closes: a ghoul that comes alone is no feast. Ghouls will not follow you down a narrow passage one at a time, so waiting there does no good; above all, never be held where the pack can reach you.

pack_hamstring.sign: {The} watches your legs, not your eyes.
pack_hamstring.cue: {The} hunts with {his} pack and goes for your legs.
pack_hamstring.does: Wolves hunt together: while one holds your eyes, another slips behind you and bites at your hamstring, and a hamstrung hero is slowed.
pack_hamstring.counter: Keep your back to a wall so no wolf can get behind you, and kill one fast so it is never two on one. Wolves will not follow you down a narrow passage one at a time: the pack waits outside it, or comes round.

pack_harry.sign: {The} hangs back and watches you, as if waiting for something.
pack_harry.cue: {The} hunts the wounded, bolder as you bleed.
pack_harry.does: {He} hunts the wounded: once you are badly hurt, the whole pack closes in and bites harder.
pack_harry.counter: Fight the pack while you are fresh, heal before you are down to half, and kill the boldest first.

pack_sling.does: Goblins pelt you with sling stones from afar while more of the pack gathers, then rush you all together.
pack_sling.counter: Close on the slingers before the rest arrive, or keep stone between you and the pack.

pack_traps.sign: {The} carries a coil of cord and a pouch that clinks with iron.
pack_traps.cue: {The} lays snares and caltrops where {he} goes.
pack_traps.does: Kobolds lay snares and caltrops round a den, and drop more as each one backs away, so whoever chases a kobold steps in it.
pack_traps.counter: Never chase a kobold blindly. Watch the floor where it has just stood, and disarm what it dropped (P) or step round it.

pack_bay.sign: {The} lifts {his} nose and tests the air.
pack_bay.cue: {The} bays to bring the pack to your scent.
pack_bay.does: Hounds hunt by scent and voice: the first to find you bays, the whole pack comes running, and the hounds follow your scent wherever you go for a while.
pack_bay.counter: Kill the first hound before the rest arrive, or be ready for the whole pack: running will not lose it.

pack_dart.sign: {The} never stands still: {he} circles, yips and edges in.
pack_dart.cue: {The} darts in to bite, then out of reach.
pack_dart.does: Jackals dart in to bite and back out of reach, each in turn, so you can never pin one down.
pack_dart.counter: Strike the one that has just bitten you while it is still beside you. Never chase a jackal across a room: it is faster than you.

pack_snatch.sign: {The} eyes your pack, and the food in it.
pack_snatch.does: Harpies snatch food out of your pack and fly off with it, as the harpies robbed the table of the blind king Phineus.
pack_snatch.counter: Kill the thief and what {he} took falls where {he} dies. Keep the flock off you, or fight where a harpy cannot swoop.

countdown_voice.sign: {The} stands silent and watches you, its great chest filling.
countdown_voice.does: {He} barks three times, slowly; whoever is still in {his} sight at the third bark is overtaken by terror.
countdown_voice.counter: Get out of {his} sight before the third bark: a wall or a corner is shelter, as a house was in the Highlands. Wax in the ears stops the bark too.

metal_eater.sign: Needles, spoons and spear-heads bristle half-swallowed from {the}'s hide.
metal_eater.cue: {The} eats iron, and your blade with it.
metal_eater.does: {He} eats iron: a blade of iron or steel that bites {him} may be gnawed blunt, and every mouthful mends {him}.
metal_eater.counter: Strike {him} with something {he} cannot eat: fire, a coating of fire oil, a silver, bronze or wooden weapon, or a named blade.

corpse_hop.sign: {The} grins with a face that does not fit the body {he} wears.
corpse_hop.cue: Slain, {the} leaps into the nearest corpse.
corpse_hop.does: When the body {he} wears falls, the spirit slips into the nearest corpse and gets up again.
corpse_hop.counter: Harvest or search the dead lying near the fight before you finish {him}, or cast Banishment on {him}: a spirit sent away finds no body.

parley.sign: {The} rises from the water and calls out, as if waiting for an answer.
parley.cue: {The} and {his} kin ask a riddle in verse.
parley.does: {He} and {his} kin ask a riddle in verse; a good answer lets you pass, and a poor one brings the storm down on you.
parley.counter: Answer well: it is a question of words and the way a sentence is built.

appeased_by.sign: {The} sniffs at your pack with a starving look.
appeased_by.cue: A gift of food can turn {the} away.
appeased_by.does: Hunger drives {him}, and a gift of food can turn {him} away.
appeased_by.counter: Set down a ration or some plain food near {him}: {he} eats it and leaves you be.

on_stunned.sign: Water slops in a dish on the top of {the}'s head.
on_stunned.cue: {The}'s strength is in the water on {his} head.
on_stunned.does: {His} strength is in the water on {his} head.
on_stunned.counter: Knock {him} senseless and the water spills: {his} arms go weak.

hidden_overhead.sign: Something hangs among the shadows of the roof above {the}.
hidden_overhead.cue: {The} hangs overhead and drops on passers-by.
hidden_overhead.does: {He} hangs overhead in the dark and drops on whoever passes under.
hidden_overhead.counter: Carry a light: in its glow you see {him} waiting above you.

weak_spot_chain.sign: {The}'s matted hide is thick as tree bark, except at the belly.
weak_spot_chain.cue: {The}'s hide gives only at the soft belly.
weak_spot_chain.does: {His} hide turns weak blows; only the soft place at {his} navel gives.
weak_spot_chain.counter: Only a long chain of right answers finds the soft place: fire works too.

sheds_skin.sign: Old skins hang in tatters from {the}'s coils.
sheds_skin.cue: {The} sheds a skin, and {his} wounds with it.
sheds_skin.does: When {he} is badly hurt {he} sheds a skin and the worst of {his} wounds with it, but {he} has only so many skins.
sheds_skin.counter: Press on through each shedding: the skins run out.

carry_off.sign: {The}'s talons are big enough to close round a horse.
carry_off.cue: {The} can snatch you up and drop you far away.
carry_off.does: {He} can snatch you up and drop you far away, hurt and alone.
carry_off.counter: A heavy load makes you harder to lift: weighed down by your gear, you are snatched half as often.

ranged_pull.sign: The air moves toward {the} as {he} breathes.
ranged_pull.does: {He} breathes in, and the pull of {his} breath drags you toward {his} coils from far away.
ranged_pull.counter: Stay out of {his} sight, or fight {him} where you want to be: the breath only draws you in.

gold_gatherer.cue: {The} lives for gold and tracks a thief by scent.
gold_gatherer.does: {He} lives for gold and follows a thief by scent.
gold_gatherer.counter: Drop a little gold and {he} stops to gather it, as the camels of Herodotus' tale were let go to slow the ants.

steal_offering.sign: {The}'s needle-thin throat works as {he} looks at your pack.
steal_offering.cue: {The} snatches food from your pack and eats it.
steal_offering.does: {He} snatches food out of your pack and crams it down, and it is gone.
steal_offering.counter: Keep your rations few when {he} is near, or set one down for {him} freely: an offering quiets {him}.

fumbling.sign: Bad luck hangs round {the} like smoke.
fumbling.does: Ill luck clings to whoever {he} looks on: you drop the first thing you handle.
fumbling.counter: Put out {his} eye or finish {him} fast. In Guard (Shift+S) you hold on to what you handle.

strangulation.sign: {The} has long, strong fingers that never stop moving.
strangulation.does: {He} grips you by the throat and holds you under.
strangulation.counter: Break free fast and keep out of {his} grip; a free hand is your best friend.

heal_blocked.sign: A smell of old spices and rot hangs round {the}.
heal_blocked.cue: {The}'s touch leaves wounds slow to mend.
heal_blocked.does: {His} touch leaves a wound that will not mend for a while, by potion or by prayer.
heal_blocked.counter: Do not let {him} touch you, or fight {him} with fire: old linen burns.

talisman.sign: {The} hops stiffly, arms out, a strip of yellow paper fluttering at {his} brow.
talisman.cue: {The} finds the living by their breath.
talisman.does: {He} finds a living man by his breath.
talisman.counter: Read any scroll with {him} in your sight: the written page stops {him} like a talisman. Standing still holds your breath from {him}.

breath_recharge.cue: {The} breathes, then must draw breath again.
breath_recharge.does: {He} breathes, then must draw breath again for a few turns. Meanwhile {he} fights you in reach with tooth and claw, in {his} full fury.
breath_recharge.counter: Strike hard while {he} draws breath. When the smoke at {his} jaws says the breath is back, put stone between you.

heals_allies.sign: {The} stays close behind the others, eyeing every wound.
heals_allies.does: {He} mends a badly hurt friend, then must rest {his} voice a few turns before the next.
heals_allies.counter: Kill {him} first, or finish the friend {he} has just mended before {he} can mend again.

life_drain.sign: The air about {the} is thin and cold, like the air of a tomb.
life_drain.does: {His} touch takes life that rest will not give back: your greatest health falls with every blow {he} lands.
life_drain.counter: Do not let {him} touch you often. What {he} takes comes back half with a night's sleep on the next floor down, and all of it from a physician or a strong prayer.

light_shy.sign: {The} squints and turns {his} face from every lamp.
light_shy.does: {He} hates a bright light: in its glare {he} strikes worse, and a troll's wounds will not close in it.
light_shy.counter: Carry a lit light or cast Light, and fight {him} inside its glow. The Light spell's glare hurts {him} most.

hold_swallow.sign: {The} is wide enough to take a man whole.
hold_swallow.does: {He} takes you inside {him}, and {his} gut eats at you every turn, though nothing else can reach you there.
hold_swallow.counter: Cut your way out: one hard blow from inside frees you. The Galdr of Loosing keeps {him} from taking you.

hold_constrict.sign: {The} moves in long, slow loops and is never quite still.
hold_constrict.cue: {The} can wrap round you and squeeze.
hold_constrict.does: {He} wraps round you and squeezes every turn, and while {he} has you, you cannot walk away.
hold_constrict.counter: One hard blow on {him} breaks the coils, or struggle free. The Galdr of Loosing keeps any coil off you.

hold_drag.does: {He} seizes you and drags you toward the water, and at its edge pulls you under.
hold_drag.counter: Strike {him} hard to tear free, and keep away from the water's edge. The Galdr of Loosing keeps {his} grip off you.

aura_fear.sign: The air goes cold and still wherever {the} turns.
aura_fear.does: Dread rolls off {him}: the first time you see {him} close, your will must hold or you flee.
aura_fear.counter: A strong will or a ward against fear keeps you steady, and once you have stood it, {he} cannot frighten you again this fight.

casts_curse.sign: {The} mutters under {his} breath and will not meet your eye.
casts_curse.cue: {The} lays curses with a muttered chant.
casts_curse.does: {He} draws a curse up for a turn, then lays it on you: a binding, a dread, a darkness of the eyes.
casts_curse.counter: Strike {him} while {he} chants and the curse breaks; wax in your ears stops a spoken one, and a mirror an evil eye.

aura_heat.sign: The air shimmers with heat round {the}.
aura_heat.does: Standing beside {him} scorches you every turn.
aura_heat.counter: A fire ward or a draught against fire turns the heat or halves it; a sling, a bow or a wand keeps you out of it.

aura_cold.sign: Frost creeps over the stones where {the} stands.
aura_cold.does: Standing beside {him} numbs you with cold every turn.
aura_cold.counter: A draught against cold halves it and a cold shield turns it; a sling, a bow or a wand keeps you out of it.

aura_stench.sign: A heavy reek hangs in the air round {the}.
aura_stench.does: Standing in {his} reek can turn your stomach, until you get used to it.
aura_stench.counter: Stand it once and it no longer touches you this fight; or fight {him} from beyond {his} reek.

second_shape.cue: Badly hurt, {the} turns into a beast.
second_shape.does: Badly hurt, {he} changes shape into a beast, with new and harder blows.
second_shape.counter: Finish {him} before half {his} health is gone, and bring what the beast fears.

casts_ward.sign: Old charms and fetishes hang about {the}.
casts_ward.cue: Hurt, {the} chants a ward up about {himself}.
casts_ward.does: Hurt, {he} chants a ward up about {himself}, and your blows land weak until it fades.
casts_ward.counter: Strike {him} while {he} chants and the ward never rises; a spell, a wand or a thrown flask goes through it.

casts_dispel.sign: {The}'s fingers trace signs that unravel in the air.
casts_dispel.cue: {The} can tear your spells off you.
casts_dispel.does: {He} can tear one of your spells off you: a haste, a shield, a ward of fire.
casts_dispel.counter: Silence {him} first, or cast your strongest spell when {he} is spent.

casts_darkness.does: {He} puts out the light you carry and ends your Light spell.
casts_darkness.counter: Carry a light that never goes out, or a spare torch; silence {him} and the dark stays away.

casts_escape.sign: {The} never stands with {his} back to a wall.
casts_escape.cue: Caught, {the} steps into nothing and away.
casts_escape.does: Hurt and caught beside you, {he} steps into nothing and is four paces off.
casts_escape.counter: Hold {him} still before you close in, or reach {him} with a sling, a bow or a wand.

carries_fire.sign: {The} carries a clay pot stopped with a rag.
carries_fire.cue: {The} carries a fire pot to throw.
carries_fire.does: From a few paces off {he} throws it: oil that bursts into flame on you.
carries_fire.counter: Close in before {he} throws, or keep stone between you; a fire ward halves the flames.

carries_potion.sign: A stoppered flask hangs at {the}'s belt.
carries_potion.does: Badly hurt, {he} drinks it and {his} wounds close.
carries_potion.counter: Strike hard before {he} can drink, and the potion is yours when {he} falls.

territorial.sign: {The} keeps close to one place, as if guarding it.
territorial.does: {He} will not follow you far from {his} ground, and on it {he} never runs.
territorial.counter: Hurt, leave {his} ground and {he} lets you go; rest, and come back.

bargains.sign: {The} jingles a heavy purse and grins.
bargains.cue: {The} darts at your back, and bargains when cornered.
bargains.does: {He} keeps out of reach and darts in when you turn your back; caught, {he} offers {his} gold for {his} freedom.
bargains.counter: Back {him} into a corner: take the purse, or refuse and fight for all {he} carries.

skittish.sign: {The} flits about at the edge of sight.
skittish.cue: {The} keeps {his} distance and darts at your back.
skittish.does: {He} keeps a few paces off and darts in when you turn your back.
skittish.counter: Back {him} into a corner, or reach {him} with a sling, a bow or a wand.

snuffs_light.sign: The flames near {the} gutter and bow.
snuffs_light.cue: {The}'s blows can put out your light.
snuffs_light.does: {His} blows can put out the light in your hand, and a wet wick will not light again at once.
snuffs_light.counter: Keep a spare light, or carry one that never goes out.

raises_alarm.sign: {The} keeps looking about, ready to shout.
raises_alarm.cue: {The} will shout for help when {he} sees you.
raises_alarm.does: When {he} first sees you {he} raises the alarm, and the rest come running.
raises_alarm.counter: Kill or silence {him} before {he} sees you, or move quietly and keep out of sight.

death_throes.sign: {The} looks swollen, as if something inside {him} wants out.
death_throes.does: When {he} dies {he} bursts, and everything beside {him} is caught in it.
death_throes.counter: When {he} swells, step back or finish {him} from a distance.

relurks.sign: Old webbing and husks hang above where {the} waits.
relurks.does: Hurt and out of your sight, {he} goes back into hiding to drop on you again.
relurks.counter: Finish {him} before {he} gets away. Once {he} hides, look for {him} with Hecate's Torch or, for vermin, Tremor-Sense.

hides_in_dark.sign: {The} is hard to keep in view, as if the shadows lean toward {him}.
hides_in_dark.cue: {The} hides in the dark between blows.
hides_in_dark.does: When {he} breaks off {he} hides in the dark, unseen, until {he} strikes again.
hides_in_dark.counter: A lit light leaves {him} no dark to hide in.

shove.sign: {The} is built like a battering ram.
shove.does: {His} blows can throw you back a step, and a clever one throws you into what hurts.
shove.counter: Fight {him} with your back to a wall, and keep clear of fire and pits.

mind_cunning.sign: {The} watches you, and keeps glancing at {his} friends.
mind_cunning.does: {He} waits for {his} friends, will not follow you into a corridor, and goes for whoever is bleeding, your pet too.
mind_cunning.counter: Kill {him} before the rest come up, call a badly hurt pet back to its Soul Sphere, and do not wait in a corridor for {him} to come to you.

mind_soldier.sign: {The} keeps {his} place in the line like a drilled soldier.
mind_soldier.does: {He} holds a line with {his} fellows, changes places when the front man tires, and may feign flight to draw you out of a narrow way.
mind_soldier.counter: Finish a hurt one before {he} can step back, and do not follow a foe who runs too neatly. Study the kind and you will see through the feint.

mind_trickster.cue: {The} slips round to come at your side.
mind_trickster.does: {He} slips round to your side and will not be drawn into a narrow way.
mind_trickster.counter: Fight with a wall at your back, or draw {him} out with a ranged attack.

mind_caster.sign: {The} hangs back behind the others, muttering.
mind_caster.cue: {The} casts at you from behind {his} friends.
mind_caster.does: {He} keeps {his} distance and casts at you over {his} friends.
mind_caster.counter: Silence {him}, or reach {him} past the others with a ranged attack or a spell.

dark_edge.sign: {The} keeps to the shadows at the very edge of your light.
dark_edge.cue: {The} strikes from the edge of your light.
dark_edge.does: {He} steps out of your light and strikes first when you come close; an archer of {his} kind shoots from the dark, where you cannot see to shoot back.
dark_edge.counter: Carry a brighter light or cast Light: the farther you see, the less dark there is for {him} to hide in.

knows_traps.sign: {The} picks {his} way across the floor as if {he} knew every stone.
knows_traps.does: {He} never steps on the snares and hazards of {his} own ground, and waits where your straight way to {him} runs over one.
knows_traps.counter: Look before you charge, find the traps first, or come at {him} another way.

band_orders.sign: {The} shouts orders, and the others obey.
band_orders.cue: {The} leads the band and shouts its orders.
band_orders.does: While {he} lives and can shout, {his} band keeps a guard in front of {him}, charges when you are hurt, and falls back round {him} when half of them are down.
band_orders.counter: Kill or silence the leader first. Wax in your ears keeps out the words, not the orders.
